name: Newsroom Broadcast
tagline: Breaking-news deck with dark globe backdrops, red lower-thirds, live tickers, split screens, and broadcast alert layouts.

palette.description: Dark navy and black newsroom surfaces with urgent red lower-thirds, broadcast blue map fields, steel highlights, and white type.

typography.style: Condensed broadcast headline type paired with compact newsroom body copy.

best_for: Company announcements, incident updates, live market/news briefings, public affairs decks, and urgent executive updates.
avoid_for: Quiet research reports, luxury brand launches, or calm workshop material where the breaking-news tension would feel excessive.

source_inspiration.name: SlidesCarnival Breaking News Slides
source_inspiration.notes: Independent high-fidelity HTML/CSS reconstruction based on public preview thumbnails: dark globe backgrounds, red broadcast bars, live labels, split screens, and ticker composition. No source assets are embedded.
